source: Annual of the British School at Athens article on Early Bronze Age seal impressions from Therasia

claims.comparison: symbol appears on Minoan seals as decorative motif and with Archanes Script signs; Decorte Appendix I AS*13 cited
claims.effect: Adds later external comparandum to AS*13; does not expand Archanes corpus.

claims.comparison: partially preserved bifoliate motif compared with Prepalatial and Cretan Hieroglyphic contexts

guardrails: Therasia material is not admitted to the Archanes Script corpus on formal resemblance alone.
Cross-Aegean motif comparison does not establish writing, sign identity, phonetic value, or transmission.
